== Executive Summary

ProximaDB's unified cache architecture provides a multi-tier, intelligent caching system that optimizes data access across cloud storage, local disk, and memory. The system features specialized caches for different data types, cross-cache orchestration, and predictive prefetching based on access patterns.

[NOTE]
====
**Implementation Status**: ✅ COMPLETE +
**Core Module**: `/src/storage/cache/orchestrator.rs` +
**Specialized Caches**: `/src/storage/cache/specialized/`
====

== Cache Hierarchy and Data Flow

=== Three-Tier Storage Model

....
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Cloud Storage (Cold)             │
│   • Unlimited capacity                   │
│   • 100-500ms latency                    │
│   • $0.023/GB/month (S3 Standard)        │
└────────────────┬─────────────────────────┘
                 │ Prefetch & Evict
                 ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Disk Cache (Warm)                │
│   • 100GB default (configurable)         │
│   • 0.1-1ms latency                      │
│   • Staging for atomic operations        │
└────────────────┬─────────────────────────┘
                 │ mmap & Load
                 ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         Memory Cache (Hot)               │
│   • 10GB default (10% of RAM)            │
│   • 50-100ns latency                     │
│   • LRU/LFU/ARC eviction                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
....

=== Cache Access Pattern

[mermaid]
----
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Orchestrator
    participant MemCache
    participant DiskCache
    participant CloudStorage
    
    Client->>Orchestrator: Request data
    Orchestrator->>MemCache: Check memory
    
    alt Memory Hit
        MemCache-->>Client: Return data (50ns)
    else Memory Miss
        Orchestrator->>DiskCache: Check disk
        alt Disk Hit
            DiskCache->>MemCache: Load to memory
            MemCache-->>Client: Return data (1ms)
        else Disk Miss
            Orchestrator->>CloudStorage: Fetch from cloud
            CloudStorage->>DiskCache: Download
            DiskCache->>MemCache: Load to memory
            MemCache-->>Client: Return data (200ms)
        end
    end
    
    Orchestrator->>Orchestrator: Track access pattern
----

== Specialized Cache Components

=== VectorStore - Hot Vector Cache

[source,rust]
----
pub struct VectorStore {
    // LRU cache for frequently accessed vectors
    vectors: Arc<Mutex<LruCache<VectorKey, Vec<f32>>>>,
    
    // Quantized representations for memory efficiency
    quantized: Arc<DashMap<VectorKey, QuantizedVector>>,
    
    // Statistics for adaptive sizing
    stats: Arc<CacheStats>,
    
    config: VectorStoreConfig,
}

impl VectorStore {
    /// Hierarchical lookup: quantized → full precision
    pub async fn get_vector(&self, key: &VectorKey) -> Option<Vec<f32>> {
        // Check quantized first (90% smaller)
        if let Some(quantized) = self.quantized.get(key) {
            if self.should_use_quantized() {
                return Some(quantized.decompress());
            }
        }
        
        // Fall back to full precision
        self.vectors.lock().await.get(key).cloned()
    }
}
----

pub struct IndexNodeCache {
    // HNSW graph nodes by layer
    layers: Vec<Arc<DashMap<NodeId, HnswNode>>>,

    vector: Option<Vec<f32>>,  // Optional, may use ID only
    neighbors: Vec<Vec<NodeId>>, // Per layer

}

=== Implementation

[source,rust]
----
pub struct CrossCacheOrchestrator {
    // All specialized caches
    vector_store: Arc<VectorStore>,
    query_cache: Arc<QueryCache>,
    bitmap_cache: Arc<BitmapFilterCache>,
    index_cache: Arc<IndexNodeCache>,
    metadata_store: Arc<MetadataStore>,
    
    // Pattern tracking for prefetch
    pattern_tracker: Arc<AccessPatternTracker>,
    
    // Global cache configuration
    config: OrchestratorConfig,
    
    // Metrics collection
    metrics: Arc<CacheMetrics>,
}

impl CrossCacheOrchestrator {
    /// Coordinated eviction across all caches
    pub async fn handle_memory_pressure(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let pressure = self.calculate_memory_pressure();
        
        if pressure > 0.9 {
            // Critical: Evict aggressively
            self.emergency_eviction().await?;
        } else if pressure > 0.7 {
            // Warning: Selective eviction
            self.selective_eviction().await?;
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Predictive prefetching based on patterns
    pub async fn prefetch_correlated(&self, key: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let correlated = self.pattern_tracker
            .get_correlated_keys(key)
            .await?;
        
        for (related_key, confidence) in correlated {
            if confidence > 0.7 {
                self.prefetch_item(&related_key).await?;
            }
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }
}
----

=== Correlation Matrix

....
Correlation Matrix Example:

         Vec_A  Vec_B  Vec_C  Vec_D  Vec_E
Vec_A    1.00   0.85   0.72   0.15   0.08
Vec_B    0.85   1.00   0.68   0.22   0.11  
Vec_C    0.72   0.68   1.00   0.31   0.19
Vec_D    0.15   0.22   0.31   1.00   0.91
Vec_E    0.08   0.11   0.19   0.91   1.00

Interpretation:
• Vec_A and Vec_B are highly correlated (0.85)
  → When A is accessed, prefetch B
• Vec_D and Vec_E are highly correlated (0.91)
  → When D is accessed, prefetch E
• Low correlation (<0.3) → No prefetching
....

[cache]
# Global settings
enabled = true
cache_dir = "/var/cache/proximadb"
max_total_size_gb = 10

# Per-cache configuration
[cache.vector_store]
max_size_mb = 2048
eviction_policy = "lru"
enable_quantized = true
quantized_ratio = 0.3  # 30% quantized, 70% full

[cache.query_cache]
max_size_mb = 500
ttl_seconds = 300
max_entries = 10000

[cache.access_pattern]
enable_tracking = true
enable_prefetch = true
correlation_threshold = 0.7
history_size = 10000

== Atomic Operations and Consistency

=== Staging for Atomic Writes

[mermaid]
----
sequenceDiagram
    participant Writer
    participant Staging
    participant Cache
    participant Cloud
    
    Writer->>Staging: Write to staging/<uuid>
    Note over Staging: File complete
    
    par Atomic Local Move
        Staging->>Cache: mv staging/<uuid> cache/file
    and Atomic Cloud Upload
        Staging->>Cloud: Upload with temp name
        Cloud->>Cloud: Atomic rename
    end
    
    Writer->>Writer: Update metadata
    Note over Cache,Cloud: Consistent state
----

=== Compaction-Aware Eviction

....
Before Compaction:
Cache/
├── collection_1/
│   ├── sst_001.sst  ← Being compacted
│   ├── sst_002.sst  ← Being compacted
│   ├── sst_003.sst  ← Keep (not in compaction)
│   └── sst_004.sst  ← Keep (recently flushed)

During Compaction:
1. Mark sst_001, sst_002 as "compacting"
2. Create new file in staging/
3. Complete compaction

After Compaction:
Cache/
├── collection_1/
│   ├── sst_003.sst  ← Preserved
│   ├── sst_004.sst  ← Preserved
│   └── sst_005.sst  ← New compacted file
....

== Memory Management

=== Adaptive Sizing

[source,rust]
----
impl CrossCacheOrchestrator {
    /// Dynamically adjust cache sizes based on workload
    pub async fn adaptive_resize(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let stats = self.collect_statistics().await?;
        
        // Calculate efficiency (hit rate / size)
        let efficiencies: Vec<(CacheType, f64)> = stats
            .iter()
            .map(|(cache, stat)| {
                let efficiency = stat.hit_rate / (stat.size_mb as f64);
                (cache.clone(), efficiency)
            })
            .collect();
        
        // Redistribute memory to most efficient caches
        for (cache_type, efficiency) in efficiencies {
            let new_size = self.calculate_optimal_size(
                cache_type,
                efficiency,
                stats.total_available_mb,
            );
            
            self.resize_cache(cache_type, new_size).await?;
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }
}
----

== Integration with Storage Engines

=== SST Integration

[source,rust]
----
impl SstReader {
    async fn read_with_cache(&self, key: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
        // Check bloom filter cache first
        if !self.cache.bloom_might_contain(key).await {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        
        // Check metadata cache for block location
        let block_meta = self.cache.get_block_metadata(key).await?;
        
        // Try memory cache
        if let Some(data) = self.cache.get_from_memory(&block_meta).await {
            return Ok(Some(data));
        }
        
        // Try disk cache
        if let Some(data) = self.cache.get_from_disk(&block_meta).await {
            self.cache.promote_to_memory(data.clone()).await;
            return Ok(Some(data));
        }
        
        // Fetch from cloud
        let data = self.fetch_from_cloud(&block_meta).await?;
        self.cache.insert_all_tiers(data.clone()).await;
        Ok(Some(data))
    }
}
----

=== VIPER Integration

[source,rust]
----
impl ViperReader {
    async fn read_column_with_cache(
        &self,
        column: &str,
        row_group: usize,
    ) -> Result<ColumnData> {
        let cache_key = format!("{}:{}:{}", 
            self.file_id, column, row_group);
        
        // Use specialized column cache
        if let Some(data) = self.cache.get_column(&cache_key).await {
            return Ok(data);
        }
        
        // Read with prefetch for related columns
        let data = self.read_from_storage(&cache_key).await?;
        
        // Prefetch correlated columns
        self.cache.prefetch_correlated_columns(
            column,
            row_group,
        ).await;
        
        Ok(data)
    }
}
----

== Future Enhancements

1. **Distributed Cache**: Redis/Hazelcast integration for multi-node deployments
2. **Compression in Cache**: Store compressed data in memory cache
3. **ML-based Prefetch**: Learn access patterns with neural networks
4. **Tiered Storage Integration**: Direct integration with S3 Intelligent-Tiering
5. **Cache Warming**: Preload cache on startup based on historical patterns
